rotation_note: Unattended-run override: NO rotating subset. All 3 core keywords plus the entire politics pool (34 keywords, grouped into geopolitics / policy_regulation / elections_public_opinion) are working keywords today (37 total). Day-of-year 317 sets ORDER only: group lead rotates so no group leads twice in a row (elections led 11-11, geopolitics led 11-12, so policy_regulation leads today, then elections_public_opinion, then geopolitics); within each group the list starts at offset 317 % group_size in pool order (policy 15 -> 2: AI bill first; elections 9 -> 2: synthetic media election first; geopolitics 10 -> 7: 반도체 수출규제 first). Queries were not checked with WebSearch (budget reserved for librarians); librarians should prefer outlet RSS/sitemap_news feeds over site: search for recency. Window: last brief was 2026-11-12, so items published 11-12 (after the prior harvest) through 11-13 are in scope. Context: Friday 11-13 in Korea / Thursday 11-12 in the US and EU at harvest time. The Dublin informal European Council on AI meets on Friday 11-13 European time — it will NOT have concluded at harvest; previews and member-state letters (Finland/Estonia letter already covered 11-12) are not new; only a published draft/adopted declaration text or a Commission package released 11-12 is new. Korea: 수능 was 11-12 — an actual AI/smart-glasses cheating incident with official 교육부/평가원/경찰 action reported 11-12..13 is new; previews of the screening measures are not. Also 과기정통부, 개인정보위 (Anthropic probe — only findings/sanction), 선관위 (2026 local elections over; only rule texts), 국회 예산 심사·과방위 법안소위. US Thursday 11-12: lame-duck Congress (NDAA AI provisions, chip-security bills), agency releases, court dockets, state AGs; New York RAISE Act portal was covered 11-12 (only other states' equivalent registries or a court challenge are new). Upcoming hooks (only official documents are new, skip previews): CCW 7th Review Conference Geneva 11-16..20; APEC Shenzhen US-China summit 11-18..19 (Bessent AI-hotline remarks covered 11-12 — only a signed joint statement/MOU text is new); House closed briefing with Jensen Huang 11-18; Meta AI-scraping terms take effect 11-20; Delhi HC Kriti Sanon hearing 12-10. In scope: bills introduced/marked up, agency rules/bulletins, court rulings and filings, regulator enforcement, export-control actions, official after-action reports on AI-enabled interference, platform takedown reports. OUT of scope: who won, seat counts, polling, horse-race analysis, commentary without a new document. Neutrality rule from sources.json applies: report decisions/filings/releases, attribute contested claims, no partisan framing.
